
#Comparison full cohort vs IHC cohorts

```{r}
library(gtsummary)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================================
# 1. Build inclusion flags on the FULL cohort (HPV-independent, deconvolution cohort)
#    TP53status_clinical_HPVind = full cohort (same one joined into analysis_data)
#    CD123_5$Case_ID / CD163$Case_ID = cases with IHC performed
# ============================================================================

cohort_data <- TP53status_clinical_HPVind %>%
  mutate(
    CD123_included = factor(
      ifelse(id %in% CD123_5$Case_ID, "Included", "Excluded"),
      levels = c("Excluded", "Included")
    ),
    CD163_included = factor(
      ifelse(id %in% CD163$Case_ID, "Included", "Excluded"),
      levels = c("Excluded", "Included")
    )
  )

# Sanity check on group sizes
table(cohort_data$CD123_included)
table(cohort_data$CD163_included)

# ============================================================================
# 2. Same variables / typing as your original descriptive table
# ============================================================================

vars_of_interest <- c(
"age", "figo_ini_ava", "tumor_size_category",
"depth_invasion_category", "hist_type_category", "vli",
  "nodal_status", "margins", "radiotherapy", "surgery_type_category", "death_disease_60m", 
  "recurrence_60m"
)

type_list <- list(
  figo_ini_ava ~ "categorical",
  tumor_size_category ~ "categorical",
  depth_invasion_category ~ "categorical",
  hist_type_category ~ "categorical",
  vli ~ "categorical",
  nodal_status ~ "categorical",
  margins ~ "categorical",
  radiotherapy ~ "categorical",
  surgery_type_category ~ "categorical",
  recurrence_60m ~ "categorical",
  death_disease_60m ~ "categorical"
)

# ============================================================================
# 3. Reusable function: Included vs Excluded table with an Overall (full cohort) column
# ============================================================================

make_incl_excl_table <- function(data, by_var, vars) {
  data %>%
    select(all_of(c(by_var, vars))) %>%
    tbl_summary(
      by = all_of(by_var),
      statistic = list(
        all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)",
        all_continuous()  ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})"
      ),
      type = type_list,
      digits = list(
        all_categorical() ~ c(0, 0, 1),
        all_continuous()  ~ 1
      )
    ) %>%
    add_overall(last = FALSE, col_label = "**Full cohort**\nN = {N}") %>%
add_p(
  test = list(
    all_categorical() ~ function(data, variable, by, ...) {
      result <- fisher.test(data[[variable]], data[[by]])
      tibble::tibble(p.value = result$p.value)
    },
    all_continuous() ~ function(data, variable, by, ...) {
      result <- wilcox.test(data[[variable]] ~ data[[by]], exact = FALSE)
      tibble::tibble(p.value = result$p.value)
    }
  ),
  pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 3)
    ) %>%
    modify_header(p.value ~ "**p-value**\n(Included vs Excluded)")
}

# ============================================================================
# 4. Build tables for CD123 and CD163
# ============================================================================

tbl_cd123 <- make_incl_excl_table(cohort_data, "CD123_included", vars_of_interest)
tbl_cd163 <- make_incl_excl_table(cohort_data, "CD163_included", vars_of_interest)

tbl_cd123
tbl_cd163

# ============================================================================
# 5. Optional: merge side-by-side into one supplementary table
# ============================================================================

combined_table <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(tbl_cd123, tbl_cd163),
  tab_spanner = c("**CD123 validation cohort**", "**CD163 validation cohort**")
)

combined_table
```
